_comment: Known competitor compare profiles. Add new entries to extend coverage without code changes. The lookup function in knownCompareProfiles.ts reads this file.

profiles.systemRole: Route multiple HDMI sources to multiple remote displays over HDBaseT.
profiles.safeProfileSummary: 8x8 HDBaseT matrix. Routes multiple HDMI sources to multiple remote displays over HDBaseT. Maximum resolution noted as 4K60; verify HDMI version, HDCP version, distance, receiver package, control, audio and power details before external positioning.

preferredCandidates.summary: Known profile override: 8x8 HDBaseT matrix candidate. Verify datasheet-level video, distance, control and power details before external positioning.
gaps: Datasheet-level video, distance, control and power details must be confirmed.
verify: Confirm IR, RS-232 and IP control requirements.
preferredCandidates.nextAction: Use as the primary WyreStorm fixed-matrix comparison path.

preferredCandidates.summary: Known profile override: long-distance 8x8 HDBaseT matrix candidate. Verify datasheet-level details before external positioning.
gaps: Verify exact distance, receiver compatibility and control set.
preferredCandidates.nextAction: Use where the opportunity is distance-sensitive.

preferredCandidates.summary: Known profile override: 8x8 HDBaseT matrix kit direction with receivers included.
gaps: Confirm receiver mix and exact receiver types included in the kit.
verify: Confirm whether this is a kit/package comparison or matrix-only comparison.
preferredCandidates.nextAction: Use as the package/kit comparison path when included receivers are required.

preferredCandidates.summary: Known profile override: 8x8 matrix kit direction where receivers are included in the box.
matches: KIT package may suit projects where receivers need to be included.
gaps: KIT package does not automatically make it a like-for-like equivalent.
preferredCandidates.nextAction: Position as a related package option only after confirming receiver/package requirements.

profiles.systemRole: Route four HDMI sources to two independently routed HDMI displays.
profiles.safeProfileSummary: 4x2 HDMI matrix switcher. Routes four HDMI sources to two independently routed HDMI outputs. Treat as a compact local HDMI matrix, not an 8x8 system.

preferredCandidates.summary: Known profile override: direct 4x2 HDMI matrix candidate. Verify detailed HDMI/HDCP, control and audio behaviour before quote positioning.
gaps: Datasheet-level HDMI/HDCP, audio and control behaviour must still be confirmed.
verify: Confirm audio de-embed and ARC requirements.
preferredCandidates.nextAction: Use as the primary compact HDMI matrix comparison path.

preferredCandidates.summary: Known profile override: larger 8x8 HDMI matrix. Only position if the customer needs extra routed HDMI I/O.
verify: Confirm whether the opportunity actually needs 8 inputs or 8 outputs.
preferredCandidates.nextAction: Treat as an over-capacity option, not the direct replacement.

profiles.systemRole: Route four HDMI sources to four independently routed remote display zones over HDBaseT.
profiles.safeProfileSummary: 4x4 HDBaseT matrix intent. Routes four HDMI sources to four independently routed display zones. Confirm the exact AVPro SKU because AC-EX SKUs are extender-family products, while AC-MX SKUs are matrix-family products.

preferredCandidates.summary: Known profile override: 4x4 HDBaseT matrix kit candidate. Treat routed outputs as four zones; mirrored HDMI is a feature, not extra matrix capacity.
gaps: Confirm exact distance, receiver mix, control and audio requirements before quote positioning.
verify: Confirm whether mirrored HDMI is required or only useful.
preferredCandidates.nextAction: Use as the primary WyreStorm 4x4 HDBaseT matrix comparison path.
preferredCandidates.matrixSizeEvidence: Source evidence: 4 HDBaseT zone outputs plus 1 mirrored HDMI output

preferredCandidates.summary: Known profile override: related 4x4 HDBaseT matrix kit. Verify current availability and receiver package before positioning.
gaps: Availability and package contents need confirmation.
preferredCandidates.nextAction: Use as the related 4x4 HDBaseT matrix path when the V2/current kit is not the right package.

preferredCandidates.summary: Known profile override: 4x4 matrix kit with mixed HDBaseT and HDMI outputs. It can be useful, but it is not a pure four-zone HDBaseT like-for-like.
gaps: Mixed output transport may not match a four-zone HDBaseT requirement.
verify: Confirm whether all four destinations need HDBaseT.
Confirm whether one local HDMI output is acceptable.
preferredCandidates.nextAction: Use only if the system design accepts the mixed HDBaseT/HDMI output set.

preferredCandidates.summary: Known profile override: local 4x4 HDMI matrix. Same routed size, different transport.
gaps: Local HDMI outputs do not replace HDBaseT distance or receiver requirements.
verify: Confirm whether remote receivers are required.
preferredCandidates.nextAction: Use when the job only needs local HDMI routing.

profiles.productClass: 4x4 HDBaseT matrix intent - verify exact AVPro SKU
profiles.systemRole: Route four HDMI sources to four independently routed remote display zones over HDBaseT.
profiles.safeProfileSummary: 4x4 HDBaseT matrix intent. Routes four HDMI sources to four independently routed display zones. Confirm the exact AVPro SKU because AC-EX SKUs are extender-family products, while AC-MX SKUs are matrix-family products.

preferredCandidates.summary: Known profile override: 4x4 HDBaseT matrix kit candidate. Verify the source competitor SKU because AC-EX40-444-KIT reads as an extender kit, not a matrix SKU.
gaps: Confirm exact distance, receiver mix, control and audio requirements before quote positioning.
verify: Confirm the exact AVPro competitor SKU before quote positioning.
Confirm whether mirrored HDMI is required or only useful.
preferredCandidates.nextAction: Use as the primary WyreStorm 4x4 HDBaseT matrix comparison path.
preferredCandidates.matrixSizeEvidence: Source evidence: 4 HDBaseT zone outputs plus 1 mirrored HDMI output

preferredCandidates.summary: Known profile override: related 4x4 HDBaseT matrix kit. Verify current availability and receiver package before positioning.
gaps: Availability and package contents need confirmation.
verify: Confirm the exact AVPro competitor SKU before quote positioning.
preferredCandidates.nextAction: Use as the related 4x4 HDBaseT matrix path when the V2/current kit is not the right package.
